item.title: Record Snowfall as the Big Freeze Continues
item.description: A major snowstorm blanketed the area, dropping over 10 inches of snow on Sunday, January 25th, forcing NYC elementary schools to revert to remote learning on Monday. Snow started falling around 5 a.m., dumping record snow in Canarsie and the surrounding areas, followed by sleet, causing icy conditions and limited visibility for pedestrians and motorists […] The post Record Snowfall as the Big Freeze Continues first appeared on Canarsie Courier.

item.title: Suspension of Alternate Side Parking Regulations
item.description: The Mamdani administration today announced that Alternate Side Parking Regulations will be suspended on Tuesday, January 27, 2026, to facilitate snow operations. Payment at parking meters will remain in effect throughout the city. Photo: Metropolitan Transportation Authority of the State of New York, Wikimedia Commons The post Suspension of Alternate Side Parking Regulations first appeared on Canarsie Courier.

item.title: Marine Park — Welcoming the Year of the Horse With Colorful Lunar New Year Dance Celebration
item.description: The cold temperatures outside did little to chill the warmth inside the Carmine Carro Community Center, at 3000 Fillmore Avenue, where the Lunar New Year was celebrated on Saturday, January 24th, with a vibrant showcase of culture, movement and community presented by the Marine Park Alliance (MPA), Assemblywoman Jaime Williams and the acclaimed Nai-Ni Chen […] The post Marine Park — Welcoming the Year of the Horse With Colorful Lunar New Year Dance Celebration first appeared on Canarsie Courier.
